name: minimum_wage_seattle_crossover
provenance: Reconstructed from raw votes per manuscript appendix G; persuasiveness from published Table 5; edges/profiles re-derived.

considerations.label: living wage / subsidy
considerations.statement: Businesses, small or large, shouldn't be able to pay workers anything below a livable wage. Why should we subsidize businesses that depend on inadequate wages? If a business's product is good, then this shouldn't be a challenge.

considerations.label: inflation protection for workers
considerations.statement: Given inflation, unless workers fight they are continually being pushed down. I think we’ll need to revisit these laws again and again to make sure the economy is working for poor families.

considerations.label: inflation and fairness
considerations.statement: $15 min wage will lead to inflation. Higher income population is penalized for this reason and therefore I don't think it is fair.

considerations.label: older-worker income
considerations.statement: During the campaign, I found out that 75% of minimum-wage workers are 20 or older. I think it’s the right thing to do to bring higher incomes to this group of people.

considerations.label: income inequality
considerations.statement: Something needs to be done to address income inequality and this is a good if imperfect start

considerations.label: small-business survival
considerations.statement: Higher wages makes it super hard for small businesses to survive.  In effect, mom and pop coffee shops with disappear.

considerations.label: automation
considerations.statement: It's just going to speed up the adoption of robotics in industries with unskilled or low-skilled workers.

considerations.label: basic-income transition
considerations.statement: One step towards a world where a basic minimum income will be the way developed nations must function as the need for human workers collapses vs populace that "needs a job."

considerations.label: service redesign
considerations.statement: I imagine new businesses opening will run counter operations where guests grab their own silverware and bus their own tables.

considerations.label: systemic critique
considerations.statement: Reactionary liberal trash. Doesn't solve the problem. It's a systemic problem and this solution is like a band aid on a broken leg.
